intelligence.enrichment: Threshing is the process in which stalks are beaten to separate grains from them. Beating harvested stalks detaches the grains, creating separated grains that may still be mixed with husk. The learner correctly applies this rule: Threshing is the process in which stalks are beaten to separate grains from them. Threshing is just another word for cleaning grain after harvest.
